name: Limerick Ham
desc: Cured, smoked over oak and juniper, boiled and glazed, the way Limerick's famous bacon houses did it. Restores 150 HP.

name: Irish Coffee
desc: Hot coffee, brown sugar and Irish whiskey, with cream floated on top, first poured at Foynes in 1943. Never stir it. Restores 100 HP.

name: Bunratty Mead
desc: Honey wine of the kind poured at the Bunratty banquets, sweet and stronger than it lets on. Restores 12 PP to every move.

name: Limerick Lace
desc: Fine embroidery worked on net, the craft brought to Limerick in 1829 and worn by half the brides of Victorian Ireland. Months of work in a hand-span.

name: Thomond Scrum Cap
desc: A battered Munster scrum cap that has stood up and fought at Thomond Park. Smells of liniment and glory.
msg: {name}'s Thomond Scrum Cap took the hit!
